docs.summary: Represents reflection information for a declaration in a shader module. Provides access to declaration metadata, relationships, and specialized type conversions.
Gets the name of the declaration.
Gets the kind of declaration represented.
docs.remarks: The kind determines which specialized reflection type this declaration can be cast to using methods like [`AsVariable`](#api~Prowl.Slang.DeclReflection~AsVariable), [`AsFunction`](#api~Prowl.Slang.DeclReflection~AsFunction), or [`AsGeneric`](#api~Prowl.Slang.DeclReflection~AsGeneric).
docs.value: A [`DeclKind`](#api~Prowl.Slang.DeclKind) enumeration value indicating the declaration type.

docs.summary: Gets the number of child declarations contained within this declaration.
Gets a child declaration at the specified index.
docs.returns: A [`DeclReflection`](#api~Prowl.Slang.DeclReflection) instance representing the child declaration.

params.index: The zero-based index of the child to retrieve.

docs.summary: Gets an enumerable collection of all child declarations.
Gets the type reflection information for this declaration.
Converts this declaration to a specialized variable reflection.
docs.returns: A [`VariableReflection`](#api~Prowl.Slang.VariableReflection) instance representing this declaration as a variable.

exceptions.text: Thrown when the declaration is not of kind [`Variable`](#api~Prowl.Slang.DeclKind~Variable).

docs.summary: Converts this declaration to a specialized function reflection.
docs.returns: A [`FunctionReflection`](#api~Prowl.Slang.FunctionReflection) instance representing this declaration as a function.

exceptions.text: Thrown when the declaration is not of kind [`Func`](#api~Prowl.Slang.DeclKind~Func).

docs.summary: Converts this declaration to a specialized generic reflection.
docs.returns: A [`GenericReflection`](#api~Prowl.Slang.GenericReflection) instance representing this declaration as a generic.

exceptions.text: Thrown when the declaration is not of kind [`Generic`](#api~Prowl.Slang.DeclKind~Generic).

docs.summary: Gets the parent declaration that contains this declaration, if one exists.
docs.value: A [`DeclReflection`](#api~Prowl.Slang.DeclReflection) instance representing the parent declaration, or `null` if this declaration has no parent (e.g., it is a top-level declaration).

docs.summary: Gets all child declarations of a specified kind.
docs.returns: An `IEnumerable<DeclReflection>` containing all child declarations that match the specified `kind`.

params.kind: The kind of declarations to filter for.
